chatMessages.text: Welcome to the Springboards Staff Hub. Use this chat to coordinate daily work schedules, safety notes, and download timesheets. No Google Workspace seat is required—just your phone number.
Reminder for tomorrow: All crews must have personal protective equipment (hard hats, eye protection, work boots) on-site by 7:45 AM before toolbox briefing.
System check: Staff portal is active and operating smoothly.

owners.scope: Deployment, DNS/SSL, runtime environment variables, and uptime
Interactive validation, 467-check Zero-Broken-Path QA, and regression checks
Metadata, canonical URLs, Schema.org JSON-LD, sitemap/robots, Search Console
Homepage 10-section narrative copy, FAQ, proof content, forms & monitoring
Inbound form routing, 1–2 business day SLA, CSP/rate-limit/session security review

readinessGates.label: Homepage matches approved conversion flow (Hero -> Problem -> Solution -> Trust -> Process -> Programs -> Proof -> FAQ -> Final CTA)
Only one primary CTA ("Apply for Training") is emphasized
Secondary actions (See How It Works, Volunteer, Partner, Donate, Documents) are clearly lower priority
All links and forms work on mobile (320px/375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px/1440px)
No broken paths, missing images, or dead routes (467+ automated checks passed)
All 5 forms have test submissions confirmed, validated, and honeypot-protected
All analytics events (page_view, button_click, form_start, form_submit_*, web_vitals) fire correctly
SEO metadata (unique title, meta description, canonical, OpenGraph, JSON-LD) is complete on live pages
DNS, SSL, HTTPS redirect, and www-to-root 301 domain routing are live
Production environment variables are configured via src/config/env.js
5-layer monitoring and 7 production alert rules are active

domainAndInfrastructure.item: DNS pointed to Firebase App Hosting (springboards-backend / us-east4)
HTTPS / SSL certificate enabled with HSTS & 301 HTTP->HTTPS redirect
301 redirect from www.springboardsfcd.org to root domain
robots.txt and sitemap.xml live and accessible
Root route and all key landing pages accessible (200 OK)

hostingAndRuntime.item: Node.js Express production stack deployed on 0.0.0.0:3000
Environment variables used for domain, admin emails, inboxes, analytics, Firebase/DB, and secrets
Production configuration separated from local/dev defaults
Debug output disabled in production; operational logs captured & retained

securityGuardrails.item: Helmet security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy)
Content-Security-Policy (default-src self, img-src self data: https:, upgrade-insecure-requests)
Rate limiting on form APIs (25/15m), general API (120/1m), and admin login (10/15m)
Strict request validation, sanitization, and silent website_url honeypot defense
Zero hardcoded internal admin values or PINs in source
Private /backoffice routes restricted behind signed HttpOnly sessions & no-store headers

performanceGuardrails.item: Gzip/Deflate compression enabled via compression middleware
Static assets served with CDN-ready headers
Compressed & optimized WebP images with responsive sizing and lazy loading
1-year immutable cache for hashed /assets/* and short revalidation for HTML
Zero critical-path render-blocking JS bundles; Lighthouse Performance & Accessibility verified

productionValidationPass.check: All 5 forms validate and submit successfully
All 7 modals open, trap focus, and close cleanly
Every CTA button is mapped to a real destination
All 6 key public pages are crawlable and indexable
All legacy/alias routes produce expected 301 status codes
No 404s on expected routes; unknown routes return controlled 404
Health endpoint (/api/health) returns expected healthy response

productionStack.role: Public routes, canonical redirects, and validated form intake APIs
Conversion funnel, referral, device & Core Web Vitals telemetry (/analytics.js)
Live programmatic metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap & robots verification (/api/governance/seo-audit)
Separated /src/routes/adminRoutes.js with signed HttpOnly sessions & Cache-Control: no-store

finalLaunchStandard.criterion: All 6 public pages crawlable, structured, and in /sitemap.xml
All routes and 301 redirects verified (0 broken paths)
All 5 intake forms validate, block spam, and confirm delivery
Analytics and Core Web Vitals beacons active
All 5 monitoring layers (Uptime, Error, CWV, SEO, Conversion) active
No critical bugs remain (467+ QA assertions passing with 0 failures)
All 5 Launch Governance owners signed off

dayOfLaunch.step: Deploy production version & verify hashed build assets
Verify canonical domain tags on all 6 public pages
Test all primary & secondary CTAs across viewports
Submit sitemap.xml to Google Search Console & request indexing
Verify test submissions on all 5 intake forms
Confirm all 7 production alert rules are armed
Confirm team knows incident escalation path (Tech -> Support -> Director)

firstSevenDays.focus: Review uptime, 4xx/5xx error logs, and initial form conversion rates
Review Google Search Console indexing status, coverage, and mobile usability
Review Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), CTA conversion, and spam/honeypot logs

launchLog.summary: Completed 11-part Launch Governance Model, separated private admin router, verified 5-layer observability & 7 alert rules, and passed 467+ Zero-Broken-Path QA checks.
launchLog.thresholds: Uptime >= 99.9% | Avg Latency < 500ms | 5xx Rate == 0% | LCP < 2500ms | CLS < 0.1

launchLog.summary: Implemented 5-layer health/error/CWV/SEO/conversion monitoring, owner sign-off gates, and automated QA suite.
